purpose: The fine times of the letters of a known text in its speech (user 2026-11-05: cutting by letters in the script, in pure Rust), as a plug-in program beside the application. The AI catalog of the host names the program and the model; nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

align.ok: { words: [{ letters: [{ letter, start?, end? }] }] }: times in seconds from the start of wav; a sign the model has not (a comma) has no times

rules: wav is a 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV file in an empty temporary folder of the application; the words are the text said in it, in order. The plug-in reads the wav and the model and writes nothing. A text that cannot be laid on the speech is an error, never a guess.
acceptance: crates/qnc-wav2vec2/examples/hear.rs (what the model hears) and tools/qnc-align-wav2vec2/examples/align_wav.rs (the letters of a known text in a WAV that is only read).
